title: are-we-there-yet is no longer supported
summary: npm states that the are-we-there-yet package is no longer supported.

constraints: Preserve weighted completion, nested tracker groups, stream progress, event timing, and completion semantics.

steps.title: Replace progress tracking
steps.instructions: Select a maintained progress tracker or implement the required aggregation locally, migrate tracker construction and updates, then remove the package.

verification.purpose: Run nested progress, completion, event, and repository tests.
